column1: # emote_events.tsv - the evidence of tools/gen_emote_events.py (round 100-EV; sadc docs/research/emotes_ev.md 2, 3.2, 14).
# Made by --evidence-from from sadc build/research/plan100/anim (census.py, bindings.py, scan_calls.py, poses.py, floor.py).
# Numbers, hashes and names only. motion: kind, object (0 main body, 1 Tails' flight body), the research's motion hash
# (content), pace (frames per 1/30 s, the most used speed of the tracked EV_SetAction calls; 1 without a call), play,
# lift (SA1 units; 0 when the root travels or rises more than 2 or the lift is over 4), root travel, rise, the first
# frame's lowest point minus the stand's, gameplay_dup (a copy of a gameplay row or extra), then for a reader: character,
# home cutscene, motion address. cast: the characters with animations bound in a cutscene (bindings.py, event copies).
